items.title: The era of AI wearables focused on listening is here
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination host Brooke DiPalma to report on the next round of wearable devices focused on listening to collect data, including built-in cameras in Meta's (META) Smart Glasses and the Apple (AAPL) Watch's use of the "Live Rewind" feature, as well as the privacy and consent concerns this could raise.
